The legacy CLI has a bug with the double colon for /56 networks (the network address of a /56 is `2001:db8:1:1200::` which ends with `::`), so appending `:iid` gives `:::`. The original code took the input line as-is. Let me fix: use the exploded 4-group prefix form as documented. Let me use the first four groups of the exploded address + ':' + iid.

Let me fix that.
